title: Resolve needs
description: What `handoff-css resolve --need` reads: what a build needs from the system. `kind` is open to later kinds (component, block); `wants` maps a mode name (or `*` for every mode) to a raw value.

name.description: The name the build would like, as the export writes it (slash-separated).

group.description: The group path the need belongs under; defaults to the name's parent.
